Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • Golden slit-pupil eyes; pink fox ears with pale inner tufts — distinct from Benio's white tips.
  • Outer robe plum-rose with gold scrollwork — pale silk is the UNDER-layer, never the read; gold floral hairpin with rose cabochon and tassel; pierced bronze incense burner.
  • Referenced in Part One as Byakuren's buried failure — read her as a predecessor, not a rival.
  • Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
